tests.metaTitle: Free Cognitive & ADHD Assessment Tests Online
tests.metaDescription: Take free online cognitive tests and ADHD screeners: Trail Making, Digit Span, short-term memory, reaction time, and child and adult ADHD questionnaires.
tests.metaKeywords: cognitive assessment test, free ADHD test, working memory assessment, attention test, cognitive evaluation, brain assessment, ADHD screening children, adult ADHD test, cognitive abilities test, mental performance evaluation, focus assessment, concentration test, executive function test, cognitive screening online, brain function assessment
tests.title: Assessment Tests
tests.subtitle: Free online tests for memory, attention, and ADHD screening. Use the results for practice and self-reflection, not as a diagnosis.

trailMaking.title: Trail Making Test
trailMaking.description: Connect numbers and letters in order, with separate time and errors for Parts A and B.

digitSpan.title: Digit Span Test
digitSpan.description: Recall digits forward or backward and review each attempt.

shortTermMemory.title: Short-Term Memory Test
shortTermMemory.description: Memorize a set of everyday items, then recall as many as you can.

reactionTime.title: Reaction Time Test
reactionTime.description: Measure how quickly you respond to a visual signal, in milliseconds.

childAdhd.title: Children's ADHD Screening
childAdhd.description: A parent questionnaire based on the Vanderbilt ADHD Rating Scale for children aged 6–12.

adultAdhd.title: Adult ADHD Screening
adultAdhd.description: The Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS v1.1), with Part A and total scores.

career.title: Career Practice Tests
career.description: Practice 911 dispatcher typing and CritiCall-style tests before a real job assessment.

tests.screeningNote: These questionnaires are screening tools only. Only a qualified professional can diagnose ADHD.
